tools.name: get_person_companies
tools.description: Companies a person or organisation holds or held officer roles in, with each role and its start and end dates, most recent first (up to 100 companies). Needs a Firmum account on the Personal plan or above.

tools.name: get_company_network
tools.description: Relationship network around a company: the people and organisations that hold roles in it and the other companies they hold roles in, as nodes and edges. Needs a Firmum account on the Personal plan or above.

tools.name: get_company_contacts
tools.description: Business contacts of a company (emails, phones, websites) found in public procurement documents, with their source. Needs a Firmum account on the Personal plan or above.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search Portuguese companies by name or NIPC (9-digit tax id), optionally filtered by distrito, CAE activity code or status. Returns up to 20 matches with NIPC, name, status, location and a link to the Firmum ficha.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Company profile by NIPC: legal form, status, registered office, CAE activity, share capital, incorporation and dissolution dates, officers currently in office, risk flags, the latest registry publications and a plain-language summary. Includes the Firmum URL to cite as source.

tools.name: get_company_acts
tools.description: Registry publications of a company (incorporation, capital changes, officer appointments and cessations, pact amendments, dissolution, accounts deposits), newest first, with a short summary and a link to each act.

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Search natural persons who currently hold officer roles (gerente, administrador, ROC, sócio) in Portuguese companies, by name; closest names first. Returns the person id to use with get_person, and how many companies they currently hold a role in. Audit firms and other organisations appear as office

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: A person or organisation that holds officer roles: name, and how many roles and companies they have (in total and currently). The list of companies is get_person_companies, which needs a Firmum account on the Personal plan.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_contacts, get_company · Private data: get_company_contacts · Public sink: get_company.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_contacts, get_company · Private data: get_company_contacts · Public sink: get_company

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
